Vendored source for the CLame target: the LAME MP3 encoder, the library half only.

LAME 3.100 (LGPL 2; COPYING and LICENSE alongside)
  https://lame.sourceforge.io
  lame-3.100.tar.gz from https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/lame/lame/3.100/
  sha256 ddfe36cab873794038ae2c1210557ad34857a4b6bdc515785d1da9e175b1da1e (the hash Homebrew's
  lame formula pins). 3.100 (2017-10-13) is the last release.

What is here, unmodified:
  include/lame.h           the public API (one level up, as the target's public header)
  libmp3lame/*.c, *.h      the encoder, less mpglib_interface.c
  libmp3lame/vector/lame_intrin.h   declarations only: fft.c and quantize.c include it whether
                                    or not the SSE code is built

Not vendored: the frontend (the `lame` program), mpglib/ (the decoder; Core Audio decodes MP3),
the rest of libmp3lame/vector/ and i386/ (x86 SSE and NASM paths), and the build system. config.h is not
LAME's: it is written by hand for Apple clang; see the comment at its top.

LAME is LGPL, unlike the rest of this repository (MIT). It is compiled into the app as its own
target. If the app is ever given to anyone else, the LGPL asks that they can relink it against
their own LAME: ship CLame as a dynamic library, or offer the object files.
